MLforSEO Academy · The AI-powered Entity Audit

Entity Extractor & Salience Profiler

Pull entities out of your content with Google's Natural Language API, then roll them up into one profile per URL — so you can see which pages are about something other than what you intended.

What you need
A Google Cloud API key with the Cloud Natural Language API enabled
Cost
Free for most audits — 5,000 units a month, then $1 per 1,000
Feed it
Paste one page, or upload a crawl export with a URL column and a content column
You get back
entity_mentions.csv and page_entity_profiles.csv

How to use it

  1. Paste your API key. It stays in this browser tab and is sent only to Google.
  2. Start with a single page so you can see the shape of the data before spending anything.
  3. Set the intended entity — what the page is supposed to be about.
  4. Read the table: the top row is what a machine thinks the page is about.
  5. Then upload your whole crawl and export both CSVs.

Worth knowing. Use API version 1. Version 2 does not return a salience score at all, and every prominence measure here depends on it.
